svg.title: PodVigil job lifecycle
svg.desc: Validate the job before spending. Arm the watchdog, create owned storage and upload inputs, then create a single Secure Cloud Pod and verify its identity. Job completion, failure, cancellation or the runtime deadline starts finalization and compute cleanup. Retrieve results after compute absence is proven. Delete storage only after verified complete backup; otherwise retain it and report billing uncertainty.
svg.text: One job from validation to verified cleanup
